surface: All base SQL used by platform, commerce and the module-embedded web router.
review: Contract 4 plus additive provider ownership on payment methods. Existing order snapshots and attempt/capture/refund/event shapes are preserved. Old native adapters do not depend on payment_methods code uniqueness; old host binaries must reject the extended migration ledger. Previous single-provider native modules remain conservative about pending work from other providers; qualify unchanged artifacts separately. Migration 5 adds nullable module policy; existing readers ignore the column, and server defaults remain effective until an owner saves a choice.
